text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)— Rain had been 
falling steadily since morning.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! For whom does the rain fall? Why, to 
make me shine brighter, of course!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-waa~... I hope I don't slip and fall...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Falling is fine too! As long as you always 
get back on your feet!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And you'll catch up in style, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa...... So precious...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hawaah!? What cold glares...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, full otaku mode engaged...! 
No, Digitan, restraint is the golden rule!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, uuum, well... I mean, of course I'm 
pushing hard for Shakur-san too...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not just "watching." I "can't take my 
eyes off it."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well then, if you'll indulge me... Excuse 
me while I take the front row...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. Declaring victory already, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Forget all that "supporting your fave" 
crap, that's way more damn interesting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You and me clashing heads... Now ain't 
that an interesting 'twist'?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Let's settle it once and for all: who is 
the true face of this generation?
